name: 钛银精密
direction: Premium titanium-silver precision, practical instrument-panel clarity translated into consumer software. Light silver neutral canvas, white or very pale metallic panels, restrained periwinkle-blue primary actions, graphite Chinese sans serif, monospaced numeric specs, 10–14 logical px corners. Signature: carefully aligned horizontal device-spec rails and small engraved-looking specification capsules. Precise hairline dividers and subtle tonal depth, not glossy chrome. No sci-fi cockpit, no dark theme, no decorative dashboards or fake analytics.
